facts.assertion: Lambeth states the Site Allocations Development Plan Document contains site-specific planning policies for 13 sites proposed for allocation.
Lambeth states it received the SADPD Inspector's Report on 3 March 2026.
Lambeth states the SADPD becomes part of the statutory development plan once adopted.
Lambeth submitted the SADPD Proposed Submission Version for Examination on 31 October 2024.
Lambeth's examination page records an update on 23 April 2026 linking the Inspector's report and recommended Main Modifications.
The SADPD examination process and Main Modifications are plan-stage evidence and do not by themselves prove candidate parcel membership.
Lambeth's public ArcGIS REST directory publishes LambethSiteAllocations as a FeatureServer.
Lambeth's public ArcGIS REST directory publishes LambethSiteAllocations as a MapServer.
Lambeth's public ArcGIS REST directory separately publishes LambethSiteAllocationsEmerging as a FeatureServer.
Lambeth's public ArcGIS REST directory separately publishes LambethSiteAllocationsEmerging as a MapServer.
The separate adopted and emerging site-allocation service names require temporal plan-stage guarding.
A service-directory listing is not a point-in-polygon result for candidate row 61522.
The GLA Lambeth local-plan FeatureServer uses EPSG:27700.
The GLA Lambeth local-plan FeatureServer reports JSON query support.
The GLA Lambeth local-plan FeatureServer publishes Site Allocations as layer 33.
The GLA Lambeth local-plan FeatureServer publishes Opportunity Areas as layer 27.
The GLA Lambeth local-plan FeatureServer publishes KIBA Land with Potential as layer 18.
A layer name such as Site Allocations, Opportunity Areas or KIBA Land with Potential is not candidate membership without geometry execution.
Lambeth published a notice for preparation of a new Lambeth Local Plan under the 2026 plan-making regulations.
Lambeth records the decision to prepare the new Local Plan as 30 June 2026.
Lambeth records publication of the new Local Plan notice on 16 July 2026.
The new plan is identified as Lambeth Local Plan 2029.
The geographical area of the new Lambeth Local Plan is the London Borough of Lambeth administrative boundary.
Lambeth expects formal preparation of the new Local Plan to begin by 31 October 2026.
Lambeth's timetable lists scoping and early participation for 1 September to 9 October 2026.
Lambeth's timetable lists Gateway 1 for 31 October 2026.
Lambeth's timetable lists content and evidence consultation for 1 July to 12 August 2027.
Lambeth's timetable lists Gateway 2 for 31 October 2027.
Lambeth's timetable lists proposed plan consultation for 3 July to 14 August 2028.
Lambeth's timetable lists Gateway 3 for 31 October 2028.
Lambeth's timetable lists examination submission for 30 November 2028.
Lambeth's timetable lists adoption for 30 April 2029.
A future 2029 plan timetable does not establish present-day allocation status for candidate row 61522.
The 2026 SADPD Inspector-stage evidence and the separate 2029 Local Plan preparation programme must not be conflated.
Candidate row 61522 remains unbound to a borough-confirmed positive future-growth allocation polygon.
The GLA Site Allocations layer-102 envelope overlaps candidate row 61522 and therefore cannot establish either membership or non-membership.
SADPD proposed-allocation status is not treated as adopted parcel binding until the statutory adoption condition is satisfied and geometry is executed.
The Lambeth GIS service-name separation is source identity evidence, not parcel intersection evidence.
No positive or negative borough candidate membership is inferred from the current web client's inability to submit parameterized spatial queries.
Business score for candidate 61522 remains unchanged pending exact authoritative spatial binding.
